description: A link to hand a person who runs a club or store, so they can claim its free listing. Opening it changes nothing: the person fills in and sends the claim on the page. If the listing is already claimed, the person can still send a claim and Hat Trick Local reviews it. Never open the link to submit for the person.

org_key.description: The club or store's org_key from a search (an older key or a plain slug also works).

name: create_claim_link
title: Claim link
